retryFailed: The retry didn't start. Try again.

list.adminIntro: Set up a Form for each kind of document you receive, and Vink will fill it from your PDFs.
list.memberIntro: An Admin first sets up a Form for each kind of document you receive. Then you can upload PDFs here.

emailIn.title: Email documents in
emailIn.description: Each Form can have its own email address. PDFs sent there become Documents of that Form.

upload.title: Upload PDFs
upload.description: Each PDF becomes its own Document. Vink fills the Form you choose from all of its pages.
upload.limit: Up to 10 MB and 20 pages each
upload.tooLarge: Larger than 10 MB. Vink takes PDFs of up to 10 MB.
upload.failed: We couldn't upload this PDF. Try again.
upload.outOfItems: You have {remaining} {remaining, plural, one {item} other {items}} left; this PDF needs {needed}.
upload.uploaded: {count, plural, one {# PDF uploaded} other {# PDFs uploaded}}

extracting.title: Extracting
extracting.description: Vink is reading these now. Each moves to Needs Review or Approved when it is done, or to Failed.
extracting.empty: Nothing is being read right now.

review.notVerifiedTip: Jev couldn't verify this Document, so it is never approved automatically.
review.doesNotFitText: Too few of {form}'s required Fields were found on it. It may have been uploaded against the wrong Form, or not be a usable Document.
review.gone: Its PDF and data are gone; only this record and its history are kept.
review.failedText: It tried four times. This is usually a passing outage, so try again. When a Reading was stored, the retry picks up from there and doesn't read the PDF again.
review.dataDeletedBy: Its PDF, what Vink read and its values were deleted on {date} by {name}. Only this record, its history and its Delivery log are kept.
review.dataDeletedRetention: Its PDF, what Vink read and its values were deleted on {date} under the Organisation's retention. Only this record, its history and its Delivery log are kept.
review.readingText: This can take up to a minute. The Fields fill in here when it's done.

changeForm.title: Change the Form
changeForm.description: Vink fills the new Form from what it already read on the PDF. Only when it hasn't read it yet does it read the PDF again.
changeForm.lost: {count, plural, one {# correction will be lost.} other {# corrections will be lost.}}
changeForm.dropped: The values for the current Form are dropped.

reject.title: Reject this Document?
reject.description: {filename} will never be approved or sent. It stays in the Rejected list, and you can reopen it while its PDF is kept.
reject.placeholder: Blank scan, unreadable, not a work order…
reject.reasonHelp: Shown to your team next to the Document.

delete.title: Delete {filename} for good?
delete.description: The PDF, what Vink read, every value and your system's replies are deleted now and can't be brought back. Deliveries that haven't gone out yet are cancelled. Only the filename, who uploaded and approved it, the dates, the history and the Delivery status stay, with a "Deleted by you" line.

pdf.failed: The PDF couldn't be shown here.
